ideas.title: Zombie Mart [Night Shift] 🧟
ideas.hook: You run the only 24-hour store in a zombie town. Zombies are paying customers as long as they get what they want fast. Serve too slowly and the queue turns hungry, and you have to sprint to the stockroom and lock the door.
core_loop: Stock shelves and ring up zombie customers for cash
Read each zombie's order (brains-flavoured snacks, bandages, lost shoes)
When the angry meter fills, run to the stockroom before the horde reaches you
Spend profits on faster tills, bigger shelves and a second floor
ideas.twist: Some customers are humans in zombie costumes. Spot the fakes before closing time for a bonus, or sell them the wrong thing and they flee.
retention: Nightly horde event with double tips
New store branches (mall, gas station, hospital)
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.84 momentum with 26 new games (high confidence; 🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 42,970 CCU, 🧸 My Small Business 26,904). Zombies sits at 1.44 (Steal and Cure a Zombie 4,916), and shop × zombies is an open gap in the data. Escape / run jumped 0.78 this week to 1.42.
ideas.differentiator: Zombie games are about fighting or surviving. Here zombies are the customers, and the shop is fun until service slips.

ideas.title: Monster Pawn Shop 🐉
ideas.hook: Adventurers bring loot from the dungeon to your counter. Guess what each item is really worth, haggle, and resell it. Some of the 'legendary' swords are fakes.
core_loop: An adventurer drops an item on the counter and names a price
Inspect it (weight, glow, runes) and guess its real value
Buy low, display it, and sell to the next customer for profit
Unlock appraisal tools and rarer customers (dragons, liches)
ideas.twist: Cursed items look the most valuable. Buy one and it haunts your shop until you sell it on to another player.
retention: Index of every item type you've appraised
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.84 with high confidence (🎃 Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 42,970, Sell a Million Sushi 11,937). Fantasy / medieval holds 1.53 across 14 new games (🍀 Tower Of Luck [1.8] 11,073), and shop × fantasy is a gap. Quiz / guess (1.29, up 0.28; Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] 12,194) adds the guessing, but it's a thin trend so it stays secondary.
ideas.differentiator: Other fantasy shop ideas make the goods. This one is about judging them, with a guessing game in every sale.

ideas.title: +1 Turnip Size 🥕
ideas.hook: Every splash from your watering can is +1 turnip size. Grow it bigger than the farmhouse, then the whole server has to grab the leaves and pull it out together.
core_loop: Water your turnip; each splash is +1 size
Buy bigger cans and sprinklers to splash faster
When it's ready, call the server for a giant tug to harvest it
Sell the turnip for coins based on size and rebirth into a bigger field
ideas.twist: The harvest needs helpers: the bigger the turnip, the more players must pull at once, so giant growers recruit the whole server.
ideas.why_now: Giant / huge rose 0.64 this week to 1.45 (high confidence; [UPD] Durian Garden 🍈 22,966, Raise The Biggest Family 21,030). Grow / farm is up 0.15 to 1.12, and the +1 formula holds at 2.29 (+1 Spider Arm🕷️ 40,000, [🎃] +1 Venom Evolution 36,742).
ideas.differentiator: Most +1 games are solo grinds. The harvest here needs other players, which turns a growth bar into a server event.

ideas.title: Launch Over the Prison Wall 🧱
ideas.hook: Smuggle spoons, sheets and springs into your cell, build a catapult, and launch yourself over the wall. Every launch goes further, but guards catch you if you land short.
core_loop: Collect contraband parts around the yard
Build or upgrade your cell catapult
Launch as a ragdoll and try to clear the walls
Land outside to escape and earn coins; land inside and you're back in your cell
ideas.twist: Each prison has more walls and searchlights. Bounce off guard towers and laundry trucks to chain extra distance.
ideas.why_now: Prison / police rose 0.35 this week to 1.19 (12 new games, high confidence; Punch to Escape! 👊 5,585, Punch Out Of Prison 4,962). Hit / swing / launch is at 2.26 ([🎃] Throw Food For Animals 162,231, Ragdoll Reality 🩸 31,576) and Escape / run jumped 0.78 to 1.42.
ideas.differentiator: Prison escapes today mean punching or digging. Here you fly over the wall as a ragdoll, with the funny physics people are already playing.

ideas.title: Plant a Penny 🪙
ideas.hook: Plant a coin and it grows into a money tree. Pennies grow copper trees, gold coins grow golden ones. Shake trees to harvest, and sneak into other players' gardens to shake theirs.
core_loop: Plant coins in your plot
Water and wait as they grow into money trees
Shake ripe trees for cash and rarer coins
Replant better coins, or raid a neighbour's garden while they're away
ideas.twist: Rare mutations: a tree can sprout gems or a coin-shaped pet. Rare trees glow, so they draw raiders.
ideas.why_now: Money / rich is at 1.94 across 56 new games (high confidence; [🎃]Climb For Animals Eggs🥚 39,488, [UPD] Durian Garden 🍈 22,966). Grow / farm is up 0.15 to 1.12 ([🎃] Steal a Forest 5,913), and steal pairs remain the strongest combo among new games.
ideas.differentiator: Money games are usually about collecting cash. Here you plant it, so every coin is a choice between spending it and growing it.

ideas.title: Fling to the Escape Pod 🚀
ideas.hook: The space station's hull is breaking. Gravity is off, so you push off walls, grab handles and fling yourself as a ragdoll down the corridors to reach the last escape pods.
core_loop: Rounds start with an alarm and a station layout
Push and fling through zero-gravity corridors
Dodge debris, sparks and other players
Reach a pod before it launches; survivors win coins
ideas.twist: Pods only fit four. Players can grab each other mid-flight and throw someone backwards to steal a seat.
ideas.why_now: Space is up 0.19 to 1.58 ([💉INJECTIONS] Ragdoll Playground 20,126, [🎃] Clean the Moon! 7,367). Hit / swing / launch is at 2.26 and the Physics Sim subgenre at 2.02 (Ragdoll Reality 🩸 31,576, Realistic Ragdoll Engine 🩸 24,158). Escape / run jumped 0.78 to 1.42.
ideas.differentiator: Ragdoll games are open sandboxes. This gives ragdoll movement a goal and a timer, with zero gravity making every fling bigger.

ideas.title: Sell Ice to Lava Folk 🧊
ideas.hook: You run an ice shop in a world made of lava. Lava creatures pay a lot for ice, but it melts the moment you step outside. Carve it, pack it, and sprint it to customers before it's a puddle.
core_loop: Mine ice blocks in your freezer
Carve them into cubes, statues or slides
Run deliveries across lava bridges before they melt
Upgrade coolers and routes to sell bigger orders
ideas.twist: Bigger ice is worth more but melts on a visible timer, so every order is a risk call.
retention: New lava regions with richer customers
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.84 with 26 new games (high confidence; 🧸 My Small Business 26,904, Sell a Million Sushi 11,937). Ice / fire / elements is up 0.14 to 1.44 (Firefighting Sim 🚒 11,338). Escape / run jumped 0.78 to 1.42 this week.
ideas.differentiator: Shop games are calm. Here every sale ends with a race against melting.

ideas.title: Mine the Sleeping Giant ⛰️
ideas.hook: That mountain is a sleeping giant. Mine gems from his back, shoulders and nose, but keep quiet: loud tools make him stir, and when he wakes the whole server has to run before he rolls over.
core_loop: Pick a spot on the giant and mine for ore and gems
Upgrade pickaxes: faster tools are louder
Watch the snore meter; when it spikes, run for the ladders
Sell gems and unlock deeper spots (inside his ear, under his hat)
ideas.twist: Any player can tickle the giant's nose to make him sneeze, blowing everyone off and scattering their loot for whoever grabs it.
ideas.why_now: Giant / huge rose 0.64 to 1.45 (high confidence; Raise The Biggest Family 21,030, steal a strange egg 7,232). Break / mine / dig is still at 1.7 but fell 0.63 this week (Break and Steal an Egg 82,245), so the giant is the main draw and mining is the familiar loop.
ideas.differentiator: Mining games use static rocks. Here the rock is alive, so greedy mining risks a server-wide panic.

ideas.title: Tiptoe Past the Dragon 🐉
ideas.hook: A dragon sleeps on a mountain of gold. Sneak in, grab what you can carry, and tiptoe out. Every coin in your bag jingles, and if the dragon wakes, everyone runs.
core_loop: Sneak into the hoard cave
Fill your bag: more gold means louder steps
Get out before the dragon's eye opens
Spend gold on quieter boots and bigger bags, then try deeper caves
ideas.twist: When one greedy player wakes the dragon, everyone inside has to flee, so the server watches each other's bags.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run jumped 0.78 this week to 1.42 (high confidence; [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It! 43,819, +1 Spider Arm🕷️ 40,000). Fantasy / medieval holds 1.53 across 14 new games (🍀 Tower Of Luck [1.8] 11,073), and steal + escape pairs drew 60,704 CCU across 6 new games.
inspired_by: [🎃] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Steal games are base raids against players. Here the threat is one sleeping dragon, and the noise of your own greed.

ideas.title: Outrun the Cops 🚓
ideas.hook: An open city where half the server are speeders on scooters and bikes and half are cops. Speeders do stunts for cash; cops chase them down. Get caught and you go to a real prison you have to break out of.
core_loop: Pick a side: speeder or cop
Speeders earn cash for wheelies, jumps and near-misses
Cops earn for arrests with roadblocks, spikes and helicopters
Arrested speeders spawn in prison and must escape to rejoin
ideas.twist: Your wanted stars stay on your vehicle. A 5-star scooter pays out huge stunt cash but every cop in the server gets pinged.
retention: Prison escape routes that change each update
ideas.why_now: Prison / police rose 0.35 to 1.19 (high confidence; Tesla Roadster Chase 9,288, Punch Out Of Prison 4,962). Escape / run jumped 0.78 to 1.42, Vehicle Sim is at 1.57 (Kukirin Life [Testing] 40,243, 🛡️[S1] Bike Universe 34,076), and realistic art is rising at 1.59 across 29 new games.
ideas.differentiator: Vehicle sims are mostly free roam. This adds a cops-vs-speeders loop and a prison break when you lose.
